cards.name: Reefgarden
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {G} or {U} to your mana pool.)
As Reefgarden enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Reefgarden enters the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Distillery of Silent Death
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {W} or {B} to your mana pool.)
As Distillery of Silent Death enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Distillery of Silent Death enters the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavorText: “One sip can bring visions of valor, the next, whispers of oblivion.”

cards.name: Brewbelly Jumbo
cards.rulesText:
When Brewbelly Jumbo enters, create a Food token.
Whenever you create a Food token, create a Beer token.
cards.flavorText: “Nobody knows how Brewbelly Jumbo keeps his beer cold.”

cards.name: Wild Fermentation
cards.rulesText:
When Wild Fermentation enters, create a Beer token for each Plant you control.
If you would create one or more Beer tokens, roll a d20 for each of those tokens instead.
1–10 | Create a Beer token.
11–20| Create a Bock Beer token.

cards.name: Desperate Foraging
cards.rulesText: Search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.flavorText: “If it’s green, it counts. Moldy breadcrumb or not—I need a joint.”

cards.name: Trained Drinker
cards.rulesText: Drunken Tolerance 4 (At the beginning of its controller’s turn, if a creature has more drunken counters than its Drunken Tolerance, remove the excess counters and put that many stun counters on it.)

cards.name: Tavern Scrapgulper
cards.rulesText:
Upkeep— Mill two cards (At the beginning of your upkeep, you must Mill two cards . If you don’t, sacrifice this permanent.)
Whenever you mill a Food card, put a +1/+1 counter on Tavern Scrapgulper.
cards.flavorText: “The tavern hasn’t ‘taken out’ the trash in twelve years.”

cards.name: Tavern Hearthkeeper
cards.rulesText: When Tavern Hearthkeeper enters, each player creates two Food tokens.
cards.flavorText: “Rule #1: Never refuse food to the hungry.”

cards.flavorText: “They cut down one tree. The rest took it personally.”

cards.name: Tavern Ban
cards.rulesText: Exile target creature with power 4 or greater.
cards.flavorText: You too drunk?” — “Not nessessessily.”

cards.name: Pushy Pourer
cards.rulesText: Whenever one or more Drunken counters are put on a creature, Pushy Pourer deals 1 damage to target opponent.
cards.flavorText: “Had enough? Nonsense. Yours is almost empty.”

cards.name: Professional Drunk
cards.rulesText:
Creatures you control get +1 Drunken Tolerance.
Whenever one or more Drunken counters are removed from a creature you control, create a Beer token.
cards.flavorText: “Getting drunk is easy. Getting the most out of it is an art.”

cards.name: Brawl Enthusiast
cards.rulesText: Whenever you attack with a Drunken creature, Brawl Enthusiast deals 1 damage to target opponent.
cards.flavorText: “Go on! He can still stand!”

cards.name: Moshpit
cards.rulesText: Moshpit deals 2 damage to each creature. For each creature that dies this way, Moshpit deals 1 damage to that creature’s controller.
cards.flavorText: “For some, the beer is just the entrance fee to the main event.”

cards.name: Brawl Encourager
cards.rulesText: Whenever Brawl Encourager attacks, target Drunken creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “Are you in or out?”

cards.name: Server Veteran
cards.rulesText: When Server Veteran enters, another target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Beers you control.
cards.flavorText: “I’ve served through worse.”

cards.name: Questionable First Responder
cards.rulesText: {T}, Sacrifice two Beers: Another target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “One for the wound. One for the pain.”

cards.name: Keeper’s Lucky Mascot
cards.rulesText:
Flying
{T}: Create a token that’s a copy of target artifact token you control.
cards.flavorText: “Turns out that shady deal for a mysterious egg paid off.”

cards.name: Wandering Culinarian
cards.rulesText:
You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
Whenever the second land enters the battlefield under your control each turn, create a Food token.
cards.flavorText: “Every land has recipes to discover. I can’t wait to find the next.”

cards.name: A Week of Excess
cards.rulesText:
I — Mill 7 cards. Put any number of creatures that were milled this way onto the battlefield under your control. Those creatures gain haste until end of turn.
II — Put two Drunken counters on each creature you control.
III — Double all Drunken counters on creatures you control.

cards.name: Kiss of Poseidon
cards.rulesText:
I — Mill four cards.
II — Choose an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard and put it into your hand.
III — You may return a creature to its owner’s hand. If it’s one of your creatures, draw a card.

cards.name: Rollercoaster of Emotions
cards.rulesText:
I — Distribute three +1/+1 counters among any number of creatures.
II — For each creature, move all counters from it onto a creature controlled by another player, if able.

cards.name: Hofi, the Fragrant
cards.rulesText:
+2 — Create a Food token.
-2 — Sacrifice a Food. Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
-6 — Sacrifice all Food you control. Each creature gets -3/-3 for each Food sacrificed this way. Each opponent loses life equal to the number of creatures that died due to this effect and the number of Food tokens sacrificed this way.

cards.name: Peter, the Manipulative
cards.rulesText:
— Whenever a player attacks with one or more obsessed creatures, draw a card.
+1 — Obsess target creature.
-8 — You get an emblem with “Whenever you obsess a creature, take control of it.”

cards.name: Sasa, the Big Brother
cards.rulesText:
— Whenever a Gnome you control dies, put a
“Lost Family” counter on Sasa, the Big Brother.
+2 — Target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life. Put a “Lost Family” counter on Sasa.
-2 — Create a 2/2 black Gnome creature token named “Another Brother.”
-6 — Remove all “Lost Family” counters from Sasa. Create that many 4/4 black Gnome creature tokens with haste named the “Vengeful Gnome Pack”.

cards.name: Stefan, the Eternal Annoyer
cards.rulesText:
— Whenever a noncreature spell is cast, you gain 2 life.
+1 — Until your next upkeep, each opponent may only cast spells any time they could cast a sorcery.
-2 — Search your library for a noncreature, nonplaneswalker card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle.
-6 — Until end of turn, you may cast noncreature, nonplaneswalker spells from your graveyard without paying their mana costs. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.

cards.name: Alex, the Cozy
cards.rulesText:
+1 — Search your library for a Forest card and put it onto the battlefield. It becomes a 2/2 green Elemental creature with haste. It’s still a land.
-2 — Deal damage equal to the number of Forests you control to target creature.
-6 — You get an emblem with “Forests you control are 3/3 green Elemental creatures with haste and trample. They’re still lands.
